enter_pin_unlock: Enter PIN to unlock this key
force_pin_change: Force PIN change on next use
reset_key_desc: Wipes every passkey and the PIN on this key. Cannot be undone.
no_auth_codes: No authenticator codes on this key.
name: Name
plug_key: Plug in a security key to begin
security_policy_desc: These change the key's security policy. Some are irreversible without a full reset — read each note before applying.
always_uv_on: Currently on — every sign-in needs PIN or biometric.
enterprise_on: Currently on. Disabling it again requires a device reset.
enterprise_one_way: One-way: disabling it again requires a device reset.
cannot_undone_full_reset: This cannot be undone without a full reset of the key.
also_force_pin_change: Also force a PIN change now
enter_device_pin: Enter the device PIN to apply this change.
resets_blocked_pin: Resets a blocked user PIN using the admin PIN (PW3).
overwrites_slot_fresh: OVERWRITES the slot with a fresh on-card key (clearable only by a full reset). May need a touch.
overwrites_slot_imported: OVERWRITES the slot with the imported key (clearable only by a full reset). May need a touch.
generating_key_touch: Generating key… (touch the key if it blinks)
wipes_all_openpgp: Wipes ALL OpenPGP keys and restores default PINs. Works even if the PINs are forgotten. No PIN needed.
resets_pin_puk_factory: Resets PIN and PUK to factory defaults; needs the management key and the current PIN.
mgmt_key_authorizes: Management key authorizes the import; the PIN authorizes the on-card signature.
removes_cert_slot: Removes the certificate in {}. The private key in the slot remains. This cannot be undone.
permanently_erases_key: Permanently erases the private key in {}. This cannot be undone.
mgmt_key_deletion: The management key authorizes the deletion. Needs YubiKey 5.7 or newer.
wipes_all_piv_keys: This wipes ALL PIV keys, certificates, and PINs.
only_works_blocked: Only works when the PIN and PUK are already blocked.
enter_dest_path: enter a destination path for the certificate
no_cert_ready: no certificate was ready to write
delete_fingerprint: Delete fingerprint "{}"? This cannot be undone.
secret_sent_note: The secret is sent to the key, not written to disk by keyroost.
permanently_wipe_oath: Permanently wipe EVERY authenticator credential on this key and clear its password? This cannot be undone.
factory_reset_every_cred: Every credential, code, key, and PIN is erased. Each applet that completes comes back in factory condition, ready to set up again.
factory_reset_piv_note: PIV: the PIN and PUK are intentionally blocked, then the applet is wiped (the standard reset path). If the wipe stops after the blocking, PIV stays locked until a reset finishes — the report below the button says what state it's in.
factory_reset_fido_finish: Finishes with a step to unplug the key, plug it back in, and touch it.
large_blob_store_readable: This store is readable by anyone holding the key and is meant for RP-encrypted data — not a place for plaintext secrets.
reset_wipes_all: This wipes ALL credentials and the PIN on {label}.
stored_as_keyroost: Stored as a keyroost entry you can read back here. It is NOT encrypted and is visible to anyone holding the key.
wipe_all_entries: Wipe all {} entries from this key? This erases every entry — including any relying-party data (e.g. SSH certificates, sign-in records), not just keyroost notes. Cannot be undone; requires your PIN.
fido_not_wiped_yet: {}  not wiped yet — waiting for the unplug, replug, and touch
